findings.meaning: The repo calls an SDK opt-out switch, but does not read navigator.doNotTrack/Global Privacy Control; browser-level signals may still be ignored.
findings.remediation: read `navigator.doNotTrack`/`Sec-GPC` before starting analytics, not only your own opt-out
findings.title: dnt-respect: opt-out handled in code (Do-Not-Track not read)

findings.meaning: Analytics/ads/session replay are present but no OneTrust/Cookiebot/Osano/… was detected; verify tracking waits for consent.
findings.remediation: load the tracker only after consent, and keep the consent decision server-side where possible
findings.title: consent-gating: trackers with no consent manager detected

findings.meaning: Personal data is collected but nothing says when it is deleted; check the privacy policy.
findings.remediation: set an explicit retention period and delete the data when it ends
findings.snippet: no retention/ttl/expiry/delete_after value in the repo
findings.title: data-retention: data collected but no retention/expiry setting found

findings.meaning: The repo collects/transmits data but ships no privacy policy/manifest file.
findings.remediation: add a PRIVACY.md/policy (or link one) and state what is collected
findings.title: privacy-doc: no privacy policy file

findings.meaning: Session replay vendors record DOM/inputs; without a masking directive the vendor defaults decide what PII is captured. Verify them.
findings.remediation: enable input/text masking in the replay SDK, or load it only after consent
findings.title: session-replay-mask: session replay with no masking option found
